title: Neural Field Tokenizations with Hierarchy and Spatial Locality Priors
abstract: arXiv:2606.08204v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural fields parameterize data as functions from coordinates to values, providing a unified framework for representation learning across modalities. Existing approaches are dominated by per-sample meta-learning, which scales poorly due to memory-intensive inner-loop optimization. The natural alternative -- feed-forward encoding -- typically introduces modality-specific assumptions, sacrificing the generality that makes learning with neural fields attractive. We argue that locality and hierarchy are useful priors for learning field representations that can be injected without compromising modality-agnosticism. We propose LH-NeF, a framework to learn general-purpose tokenized representations of continuous signals. A locality-preserving hierarchical encoder maps raw coordinate-value field observations to structured tokens, from which the field is reconstructed during training. translated_title: 具有层次结构与空间局部性先验的神经场标记化
translated_abstract: 神经场将数据参数化为从坐标到值的函数，为跨模态的表示学习提供了统一的框架。现有方法主要以逐样本元学习为主导，但由于内存密集型的内循环优化，其扩展性较差。作为自然替代方案的前馈编码通常会引入特定于模态的假设，牺牲了使神经场学习具有吸引力的通用性。我们认为，局部性和层次性是学习场表示的有用先验，可以在不损害模态无关性的情况下注入这些先验。我们提出了LH-NeF，一个用于学习连续信号通用标记化表示的框架。一个保持局部性的层次化编码器将原始的坐标-值场观测映射为结构化标记，并在训练过程中从这些标记重建场。通过用单次前向传播取代元学习的内循环，LH-NeF实现了高效的通用神经场表示学习。
tldr: 本文提出LH-NeF框架，通过注入局部性与层次性先验，用前馈编码取代内存密集的逐样本元学习，实现了模态无关且可扩展的神经场标记化表示学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LH-NeF, a framework that injects locality and hierarchy priors into a feed-forward hierarchical encoder, replacing memory-intensive per-sample meta-learning to enable modality-agnostic and scalable tokenized neural field representation learning.
